blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — The Bangsamoro government has asked the Department of Justice (DOJ) to assign a special prosecutor in the Special Geographic Area (SGA) of the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM). Chief Minister Abdulraof Macacua and Bangsamoro Interior and Local Government Minister Jordan Bayam on Tuesday asked Justice Secretary Frederick Vida to assign a special prosecutor to SGA-BARMM, citing the need to ensure residents have access to essential prosecutorial services without difficulty. Bayam said they wanted to ensure that communities have access to justice and give former Moro combatants more opportunities to rebuild their lives. READ: EXPLAINER: How BARMM’s parliamentary […]...
